description:
Cast Body Launderer by paying {2}{B}{B}. 
When Body Launderer enters, Blasting Station triggers.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing Body Launderer to connive.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger from step 2, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 6 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 7.
Repeat from step 7.
